title: The junior operator rings the web-chat customer to confirm tomorrow's booking
purpose: Story S7, day A. The web chat of the evening before became a booking at 7:36; this is the call Maya said she would make. It is outbound, so it has a transcript and no verdict: the answer to 'what score did my confirming call get' is none.

call.day: slot 6's 14th working day before T, day A of S7 (rule R6; card S07)

scenario.who_calls: Maya rings Rachel Dunlap, who wrote in the web chat at 21:10 the evening before and was booked that morning.
scenario.wants: to confirm the booking; the customer asks whether she can drive the car and where the shop is
scenario.what_happens: Maya confirms tomorrow at nine at the East Main shop, tells her to keep to short trips and what would mean a tow, gives the inspection's price and what it includes, and the address.

facts.booked: call+1d 09:00, ERP appointment, source web chat

script.said: Hi, Rachel, this is Maya at Brennan Auto Care. You were — you were chatting with us on the website last night about your CR-V?
Oh! Yes. Hi. That was fast.
We try! So I've — I've got you on the schedule for tomorrow, Tuesday, at nine, here at the East Main shop, for the brake inspection. I just wanted to make sure that still works.
Yeah, nine's fine. Is it okay to drive it till then? It's makin' that grindin'.

Um — I'd keep it to short trips if you can, and — and leave yourself some extra room to stop. If the pedal starts feeling soft, or it gets a lot louder, don't drive it. Call us and we'll figure out a tow.
And it's — what'd they say, fifty dollars?
Forty-nine ninety-five for the inspection, and that's the wheels off and everything measured. If it needs brakes, I'll show you what we found and give you a price before we do anything.
Okay, good. And where are y'all, exactly?
Twenty-one-oh-six East Main Street. Just pull up to the first door and come on in.
Okay. I'll see you at nine.
Perfect. Just ask for Maya. Thanks, Rachel!
